findings.evidence: design.md:3 "The owner's decision is recorded in BR-781 (variant A of three, 2026-10-23)" cites a private Backlog item with no docs/decisions link. spec.md says "the change's design SHALL link the record instead of restating the choice". Only DEC-0004 is added, and it covers the main-advance topic, not this choice.
findings.summary: The change's own design.md states the owner's choice (variant A of three) without linking a decision record. The delta spec and rule 2 require a record with rejected options and revisit triggers, and require design to link it instead of restating the choice. No DEC record covers the variant A choice, and the rejected variants (a separate problems registry, a fifth OpenSpec artifact) appear only in proposal.md.

findings.evidence: proposal.md:3 "at least eight times (… eight names …, plus BR-774 and BR-777)"; docs/decisions/0004-main-advance-revalidation.md attempts table has 11 rows.
findings.summary: proposal.md says the problem was attacked "at least eight times" but names ten or more changes, and DEC-0004 lists eleven attempt rows. The counts are inconsistent. The proposal also does not link DEC-0004 or issue #553 in a form that follows its own rule 3. The links appear only under "What Changes".
